open_questions.question: Does the Universidad de Chile's current Reglamento General de Carrera Académica (D.U. N°0035864 de 2019) still require a foreign title to be 'reconocido por el organismo pertinente de la Universidad de Chile', and what does that internal recognition actually involve?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is the one clause that could reintroduce a recognition step for an academic post, contradicting the concurso bases which ask only for an apostille.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Obtain the 2019 consolidated text (the 2001 version is what is publicly indexed) and put the question in writing to rrhhacademicos.med@uchile.cl.

open_questions.question: Will a Ukrainian criminal-record certificate satisfy the 'Certificado de antecedentes vigente' that both Universidad de Chile rounds demand, and will a passport be accepted where the bases ask for a Cédula de Identidad?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Both are admissibility documents; failing either makes the application 'No Admisible' before merit is even assessed.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Email the faculty concursos address before the window opens and get the answer in writing.

open_questions.question: Which Chilean medical faculty, if any, has an open or recurring academic post in RHEUMATOLOGY?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Every Universidad de Chile post examined names a specific specialty as an admissibility requirement, so a rheumatology post is the only one her Ukrainian specialty could match.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Monitor the four Universidad de Chile concurso pages monthly plus SOCHIRE and the other faculties; this belongs to lane L11.

open_questions.question: If an academic post involves teaching at the bedside, what exactly must the appointee hold — revalidación, EUNACOM, entry in the Registro Nacional de Prestadores Individuales de Salud — and who enforces it, the university or the hospital?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It decides whether Scenario A (academic, no patients) is genuinely separable from Scenario B.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Cross-read L04 and L05; ask the Hospital Clínico Universidad de Chile credentialing office directly.

open_questions.question: Does the exemption for visiting foreign academics run to ninety days under the current text of Ley 21.094, and is the article numbered 46 or 47?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is the only route found that lets her teach paid in Chile with no work visa, and the original 2018 text said thirty days.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Read the LeyChile 'Texto vigente' page for Ley 21.094 in a browser that executes JavaScript, or obtain the signed PDF export.

open_questions.question: Does any Chilean medical faculty deliver teaching in English, or accept an academic who cannot yet teach in Spanish?
open_questions.why_it_matters: She has no Spanish; if no English-track exists, Spanish acquisition becomes the critical path, not the paperwork.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Ask the international offices of Universidad de Chile, PUC and Universidad de Concepción directly; searches returned only site translations and one unverifiable commercial claim.

open_questions.question: Do any Chilean private universities' medical faculties impose stricter or looser foreign-title rules than the two State universities examined?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Private universities are not bound by the Estatuto Administrativo at all, which may make them the easier entry point.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Read the academic hiring reglamentos of PUC, Universidad de los Andes, Universidad del Desarrollo and Universidad de Concepción.

unknowns_declared: I could not retrieve the LeyChile 'Texto vigente' page for DFL 29/2004 (Estatuto Administrativo) art. 12 — bcn.cl renders article text via JavaScript and returned only a 'Loading...' shell across three attempts, and a direct curl was refused. The current wording of art. 12 letter a) is therefore taken from a Servicio Civil page that carries no date.

I could not retrieve the current consolidated Reglamento General de Carrera Académica of the Universidad de Chile (D.U. N°0035864 de 2019). Claims L06-C12, L06-C13 and L06-C14 rest on the 2001 version (D.U. N°2860), which the 2026 concurso bases say has been superseded.

The exact article number of Ley 21.094's 'Actividades de académicos extranjeros' provision is unresolved — the LeyChile XML export returned it as article 46, secondary sources cite article 47, and the two circulating texts differ (thirty days under DL 1.094/1975 versus ninety days under Ley 21.325 art. 50).

No Contraloría dictamen on the applicability of Estatuto Administrativo art. 12 to State-university academics was located. The Universidad de Chile carve-out is documented only in its own concurso bases and reglamento, not in a Contraloría ruling I could read.
No academic concurso in RHEUMATOLOGY was found at any Chilean medical faculty during this lane's searches.

I found no evidence either way of an English-taught Medicina programme in Chile. One commercial aggregator asserts the Universidad de Chile Bachelor in Medicine is taught in English; I could not corroborate this from any uchile.cl page and treat it as unverified.

Salary evidence covers only Universidad de La Frontera. I did not obtain figures for Universidad de Chile, whose Santiago posts carry no zone allowance and whose Faculty of Medicine posts are mostly 11 or 22 hours rather than 44.
The Universidad de Valparaíso bases document carries no printed publication date; 'UNDATED' is recorded, and its internal calendar shows the round closed in December 2025.
The four Universidad de Chile concurso listing pages carry no publication or update date; only their application windows are dated.
I did not verify whether a Universidad de Chile academic appointment additionally requires a RUT before the contrata can be issued, nor how long the gap between selection and contract typically is.
